get.summary: Say that this is the operator API, and where the browser Client is
get.description: For a person who opens the operator port in a browser. The Client URL is the control plane's `KESTREL_CLIENT_URL`; nothing parses this text.

200.description: Plain text naming the API and the configured Client URL.

get.summary: Read what is true of the install whatever is declared in it.
Read whether work can start, and what is missing when it cannot.
get.description: A successful read whatever it finds (ADR-0052): `outcome` says ready, blocked or unavailable. With no harness, Sign-in Method, Profile or Project named it looks for any usable path, so a broken sign-in nothing depends on is a warning; with one named it tests that path. It writes nothing, asks no provider, starts no relay and never pulls an image.

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The Organization to read. Omitted, it is the only one that exists; several and none named is an `ambiguous_reference`, never a choice.

parameters.name: harness
parameters.description: Test the path that starts work on this harness, rather than looking for any usable one.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Hold the path to what is known of this model: another model's result never stands in for it.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The Subscription Profile the work would name. Omitted, it is the Operator's own that holds the harness's subscription, as an open takes it.

parameters.name: sign_in_method
parameters.description: Test this Sign-in Method, rather than the one an open naming none would take.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Test that this Project is declared, rather than that any is.

initial_setup_complete.description: Whether the first confirmed start has committed its Workspace and Session. Durable, and independent of current readiness, of the Operator's name and of what remains to declare: naming the Operator, saving a sign-in, opening a Workspace or enqueueing a Session never sets it, and no later failure clears it.

Readiness.description: Whether work can start in an Organization, read at this request. Ready means a usable path exists, not that every saved sign-in works.

outcome.description: `blocked` when `gaps` holds a prerequisite known to be missing. `unavailable` when none is known missing but an inspection in `unavailable` failed, so readiness could not be established. `ready` otherwise.

organization.description: The Organization read: the one named, or the only one. Null when none exists.

client_url.description: The browser Client's configured URL, never one derived from this API's port.

initial_setup_complete.description: As `Install` reads it: durable, and independent of `outcome`.

sign_in.description: The saved sign-in the selected path would use, when exactly one is established. Never its material.

gaps.description: Every blocking prerequisite that could be established, in the order to repair them: the Operator, a usable sign-in on a harness the image carries, a selected sign-in needing attention, a repository, a Project. Each names its scope in `context` and its repair in `next_steps`.

warnings.description: What does not block the path: selected material nothing has checked, and broken material the path does not use.

unavailable.description: Inspections that failed. Nothing is claimed about what one would have established: a harness is never absent, nor present, because its image could not be inspected.

ReadinessSelection.description: The path read: each value as it was named, or as it resolved when exactly one choice exists. Null where nothing was named and several remain, because none is chosen for the reader.

ReadinessSaved.description: The prerequisites already saved, whether or not the selected path uses them.

sign_ins.description: Every catalogued sign-in saved where this path would look, as the sign-ins read lists them.

github_integrations.description: The names of the GitHub Integrations that lend a repository authority now: enabled, and carrying outbound.

projects.description: The names of the Projects declared.
